_comment: xAI Responses on the API-key and SuperGrok Connections. New Models infer the current Grok low/medium/high/xhigh effort ladder; exact catalog ladders and older fixed-reasoning exceptions win. Optional parameters are limited to the xAI set and, when the catalog lists supported parameters, to those it lists (max_tokens counts as listed with max_output_tokens). Effort none asks for the lowest rung because current Models cannot disable reasoning. Only JPEG and PNG images are carried. Family defaults are inferred, not live-verified.

rules.note: These older fixed-reasoning Models accept no effort control; new versions inherit the current Grok ladder.

grok-4.3.note: Grok 4.3 lists a none rung; the wire has always omitted reasoning for effort none. Kept until verified live.
